title: DataFrames transformations and grouped summaries
outcome: Transform a typed table and compute grouped summaries while preserving names, missingness and row counts.

exercises.title: Name the derived field
exercises.task: Scale the score column by 10 using ByRow.
exercises.expected: The output column contains 1,2,3 under the explicit name scaled.
exercises.answer: Names and shape are part of the resulting schema.

exercises.title: Observe a shared column
exercises.hint: The indexing operation can return the stored column.
exercises.answer: A caller must request a copy when independent storage is required.

exercises.title: Retain a column snapshot
exercises.task: Copy the column before later source mutation.
exercises.answer: A snapshot is useful for comparison and provenance when future mutation is possible.

exercises.title: Report group coverage
exercises.task: Summarize the group containing one missing score.
exercises.expected: It reports 2 rows,1 observed score and mean 1.
exercises.hint: A mean alone hides the denominator.
exercises.answer: Row accounting remains necessary after grouping.

exercises.title: Handle an all-missing group
exercises.task: Apply observed_mean to only missing values.
exercises.hint: An empty observed set needs a stated policy.
exercises.answer: A fabricated zero could change later model or business decisions.

exercises.title: Interpret a mean of means
exercises.task: Average the two group means with and without count weights.
exercises.answer: Group-level and row-level summaries represent different populations.
